_comment: TEST ONLY. Cross-cutting measures added to EVERY question. They check WHETHER the worker mentions something (an example from their own work, care or a precaution, checking the result), never WHAT is correct: they contain no trade-specific or safety facts. They only count when the answer also earns marks on the question's own topic criteria (requiresTopic), so an off-topic answer cannot collect them. A real rubric may drop them with "commonMeasures": false.

measures.description: Gives an example or describes steps from own work
Mentions care, safety or a precaution
Mentions checking or testing the finished work
